== English Official Tournament Sealed Deck comparison ==
Decipher’s November 1998 Glossary gives the complete replacement. The text keeps the deployment trigger, one non-unique alien from Reserve Deck, mandatory reshuffle and same-or-adjacent Tatooine deploy discount. It shortens the search instruction and extends the +2 piloting bonus from any starship to anything Arleil pilots. The current marked image and slip agree.
